## Case or site change

Describe the change and why it belongs in the library.

## Editorial checks

- [ ] Consequential factual claims have nearby citations.
- [ ] Source roles, access, independence, and conflicts are disclosed.
- [ ] Direct quotations are short, exact, attributed, and contextualized.
- [ ] The conclusion does not exceed the evidence or causal-strength label.
- [ ] Unknown outcomes or economics are labeled rather than inferred.
- [ ] No copyrighted source documents or large media files are included.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes locally.
